---
title: "Count FASTQ reads used per sample"
author: "Mar Llaberia & J. Ignacio Lucas Lledó"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{bash}
FASTQ=../2023-05-17/crepi_edits
if [ ! -e sampleList.txt ]; then
   ls -1 $FASTQ/*.trimmed_R1_.fastq.gz > sampleList.txt
fi

if [ ! -e totalReads.txt ]; then
   echo -e "FASTQ\tNumReads" > totalReads.txt
   i=1
   for file in $(cat sampleList.txt); do
      NUM=$(( $(gunzip -c $file | wc -l) / 4 ))
      echo -e "$file\t$NUM" > tmp$i.txt &
      i=$(( i + 1 ))
   done
   wait
   cat tmp*.txt >> totalReads.txt
   rm tmp*
fi
```

```{r stats}
library(kableExtra)
counts <- read.table('totalReads.txt', header = TRUE)
#kable(counts) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
sum(counts$NumReads)
mean(counts$NumReads)
sd(counts$NumReads)
barplot(sort(counts$NumReads, decreasing = TRUE))
plot(density(counts$NumReads))
```
